entry.title: La Nox Petit — Single
experienceTags: Pairings: Espresso, dark chocolate, cola or dark rum
entry.summaryHtml: Dark chocolate, espresso, raspberry, maple sweetness, cedar and pepper come through densely in the narrow 5″ × 40 format. The sweet Brazilian maduro wrapper and San Andrés binder build cocoa and dark-fruit richness, while Dominican Piloto and Pelo de Oro keep the finish spicy, leathery and substantial.
entry.noteHtml: Cigar World lists the exact 5″ × 40 La Nox Petit single at A$39.84.
productionLines: Filler: Dominican Piloto and Pelo de Oro
